card.name: Capital G starting a word
card.fires_on: A capital G (or g) that begins a word and is split off from the rest, such as G in Gorge, Gently, Givens, Guguyimidjir, or the Air for the G String. The next piece is usually a vowel completing the word.

modes.label: Split G-word
modes.description: A lone G stands in for the start of a word whose rest follows in the next piece.
modes.example: I cruised through the Columbia River<< G>>orge, which is very beautiful.

modes.label: Gather/guard words
modes.description: A g or eg piece begins a word like gathering or safeguards.
modes.example: cannot be exempt from this information<<-g>>athering activity.

modes.label: Before ground
modes.description: A quote mark right before the word ground in ground rent.
modes.example: you may have to pay a small amount in<< '>>ground rent' every year.

card.writes: It promotes the word ground in its forms, which is a weak fit for the G-start contexts.
card.plain: It lights up when a word starting with G is cut after its first letter, like Gorge or Gently.
